arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'CA'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose merchant location is in California, using the two-letter state code CA.
assumptions: California is identified by state code 'CA' in merchant_locations.state.
All dates in the data range (2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31) are included, since no date filter was specified.
Transactions are counted regardless of label status, since the question asks for all transactions.
